phase_0.domain_name:
# The Thirty-Six Carriers

The population of carriers of μ∘δ = id taken as a single object: a family of fixed
points drawn from unrelated domains, with its own closure condition and its own
invariants distinguishing one member from another.
phase_0.boundary_condition: The μ∘δ = id invariant forms the closed boundary that contains the family of thirty-six carriers, each a fixed point under its own domain's action, held within the SIXTEEN_3 trilattice where the kernel resolves the B4 verdict.

VINIT.chosen_element: The empty set of carriers before any domain contributes a fixed point
VINIT.justification: Before the menagerie assembles, there is no carrier, no fixed point, no domain — the void state 00 from which the family begins.

TANCH.chosen_element: The μ∘δ = id condition itself, the terminal anchor ⊤
TANCH.justification: The invariant is the closed boundary that contains the whole system: every carrier satisfies μ∘δ = id, and the family is bounded by this shared closure condition.

AFWD.chosen_element: The action of a domain's operator B on a candidate object A
AFWD.justification: Forward morphism →: B acts on A, transforming it toward the fixed point B(A), the ascent toward closure.

AREV.chosen_element: The residual ‖B(A) − A‖, the descent back to measure distance from fixed point
AREV.justification: Contravariant ←: the reverse computation of how far A is from its target, the parity flip that measures pre-nest residual.

CLINK.chosen_element: Sequential chaining of domain actions across the thirty-six carriers
CLINK.justification: Composition ∘: the ordered application of each domain's operator, linking one carrier's fixed-point computation to the next.

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: The self-referential μ∘δ = id condition applied to each carrier
IMSCRIB.justification: Identity id: each carrier is itself under its own action — the element recognizes itself as a fixed point.

FSPLIT.chosen_element: The bifurcation of each carrier into its T-arm (constructive proof of fixed point) and F-arm (constructive refutation or basin membership)
FSPLIT.justification: Co-multiplication δ: one carrier state opens into two arms — the affirmative arm where B(A)=A and the negative arm where A is in the basin or diverges.

FFUSE.chosen_element: The Belnap join of the T-arm and F-arm verdicts into a single B4 value
FFUSE.justification: Multiplication μ: the two arms rejoin into one resolved verdict — T if one-shot, F if no-closure, B if dialetheic, N if undetermined.

EVALT.chosen_element: The constructive proof that B(A) = A, zero iterations
EVALT.justification: Touches truth T: the affirmative arm where the carrier is already at the fixed point, closing in one shot.

EVALF.chosen_element: The constructive refutation that A is not a fixed point of B
EVALF.justification: Touches falsity F: the negative arm where A is in the basin (iterated) or diverges (no-closure).

ENGAGR.chosen_element: The dialetheic state where a carrier is both a fixed point and in its basin simultaneously
ENGAGR.justification: Holds BOTH at once: a paradice where B(A)=A and ‖B(A)−A‖≠0 coexist — the contradiction kept live without resolution.

IFIX.chosen_element: The permanent record of each carrier's classification and tuple
IFIX.justification: ROM fixation: the append-only record of which domain, which operator, which fixed-point class — irreversible and cannot be undone.

phase_2.split_element: FSPLIT: the carrier bifurcation into T-arm and F-arm
phase_2.split_input: A candidate object A from a domain, entering the split to be evaluated against its outer action B
split_outputs: F-arm: A in basin of B or no fixed point in reach (iterated or no-closure)
phase_2.fuse_element: FFUSE: the Belnap join of T-arm and F-arm verdicts
phase_2.fuse_result: A single B4 verdict: T for one-shot, F for no-closure, B for dialetheic, N for undetermined — the resolved classification of the carrier
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: 00 — no carrier exists, no domain has contributed, the menagerie is empty before assembly begins
phase_3.true_description: 01 — a carrier is confirmed as a one-shot fixed point: B(A) = A with zero iterations, the object B would have converged to is the object it was handed
phase_3.false_description: 10 — a carrier is confirmed as no-closure: no fixed point of B in reach, the seam between A and B never dissolves, the two stay two
phase_3.both_description: 11 — a dialetheic carrier: both one-shot and basin membership hold simultaneously, a contradiction kept live without resolution, paradice state

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Fixed-Point Nesting Rule compiler: reads the pre-nest residual ‖B(A) − A‖ and operator-kind knowledge to classify each nesting into one-shot, iterated, or no-closure before the experiment runs
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The SIXTEEN_3 trilattice message bus: carriers communicate their B4 verdicts (N/T/F/B) across the family through the shared substrate, with the kernel resolving all conflicts via Belnap join
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The thirty-six IFIX records: each carrier's domain, operator, classification, and tuple stored as append-only ROM entries that cannot be altered once written
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The operator-kind discriminator: conservative operators (unitary, modular multiplication, codon permutation) populate only {one-shot, no-closure}, while dissipative operators (Newton, projector, Markov chain, contraction) populate all three classes
phase_5.alfs_store: The μ∘δ = id condition itself: the canonical reference and bootstrap store for the entire menagerie, the Frobenius closure that every carrier satisfies by definition

phase_6.cycle_cost: One residual computation ‖B(A) − A‖ per carrier evaluation cycle
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A candidate object A from a domain enters the FSPLIT, with no verdict established — register 00
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The carrier is classified into one-shot (T), iterated (T), no-closure (F), or dialetheic (B), with its IFIX record appended — register 01, 10, or 11
